messages:
Sam: Heads-up: SpectraAI (edge analytics) wants a 12mo Dedicated commit with geo-split pools (us-west A100, ap-southeast H100). Requesting 16% off list + 2x burst, and a 1-month onboarding credit. Need Deal Desk + Finance review.
Noor: Do we have their expected monthly GPU-hours and regional split? That will change pricing and availability.
Sam: They estimate 2.5k GPU-hrs/mo: 60% A100 (US), 40% H100 (APAC). Willing to sign MSA but ask for flexible autoscale during seasonal peaks.
Marta: Deal Desk: 16% for 12mo is within possibility but borderline. Standard approval up to 15%. Need refundable onboarding credit language, capacity fallback if APAC H100 unavailable, and clear burst caps.
Tom: Finance: 16% ok if we add a minimum invoice floor (e.g., 90% of committed hours) or prepay option. Also require burst billed at a multiplier (not full discount). 2x burst at discounted rate is expensive.
Noor: Quick math: list A100= $1.8/hr, H100= $3.2/hr. For 1500 A100 hrs -> 1500*1.8 = 2700. For 1000 H100 hrs -> 1000*3.2 = 3200. Total list = 5900 USD/mo. 16% off -> 4956 USD/mo.
Marta: Proposed terms: approve 15% standard discount. For 16% we need either (a) 90% invoice floor, or (b) 1-month prepay plus onboarding credit convertible on full-term execution. Burst terms: approve 1.5x billing multiplier, burst capped at 20% of monthly commit.
Sam: Customer pushing for 2x burst multiplier and the onboarding credit not tied to conversion. They need predictable demo economics for their SOC.
Tom: We can offer 16% only if onboarding credit is refundable/convertible to invoice credit when they sign the 12mo MSA, and burst multiplier = 1.5x with hard cap 20%. No unconditional 2x at discounted rate.
legal-bot: SOW requirements: explicit invoice mechanism for burst hours, credit conversion flow, capacity fallback clause (APAC H100 -> A100 fallback at same effective cost), and data residency terms for APAC.
Marta: Deal Desk final: approve 16% with conditions: signed MSA, 1-month onboarding credit convertible to invoice credit, invoice floor 90%, burst billed at 1.5x and capped at 20% of monthly hours, capacity fallback clause. Anything outside this -> CRO/CFO.
Noor: Ops config for infra: ```pool: "spectraai-dedicated-01" regions: [{r:"us-west", gpu:"A100", pct:60},{r:"ap-southeast", gpu:"H100", pct:40}] commit_hours: 2500/month billing: {discount_pct:16, min_invoice_pct:90, onboarding_credit_months:1} burst_policy: {multiplier:1.5, max_pct:20}```
infra-bot: Created provisioning ticket: PROV-3412, tentative pools and billing params pending legal + billing sign-off.
Sam: I'll draft the SOW with the conversion language and share with SpectraAI legal. Thanks team.
Marta: Deal Desk approved (conditional) :white_check_mark: 
Tom: Finance acknowledges conditional approval :money_with_wings: 
Sam: Closing for now 1; will reopen if customer counters.
